selection_rule: Among configurations with complete successful dev agent runs, maximize dev Context Evidence Rate, then Evidence Hit@3, then Hit@1; ties favor smaller context budget, then fewer allowed searches, then config name. Answer/citation audits are reported as limitations, not used to silently retune test.

configs.name: baseline
configs.hypothesis: Lexical baseline; Vietnamese questions versus English source may miss synonyms.

configs.name: dense
configs.hypothesis: Cross-lingual embeddings improve evidence retrieval relative to lexical baseline.

configs.name: hybrid
configs.hypothesis: RRF combines lexical terms and dense semantic evidence.

configs.name: dense_context
configs.hypothesis: Larger top-k and context reduce loss of complete evidence during packing.

configs.name: hybrid_context
configs.hypothesis: More context and optional query refinement improve evidence coverage at additional latency.
